_provenance.what: THE SHARED GOLDEN, aeon half. `ojz_act1.regions.json` beside this file is the document; these are the exact Region rows it must flatten to, in the engine's INCLUSIVE form. Aeon's tools/test_regions_doc.py asserts load_act_regions + flatten reproduces them; aurora's vitest asserts its TypeScript flattening reproduces the same rows after its own exclusive-to-inclusive conversion. Spec section 5.4 (empyrean docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-14-aurora-regions-editor-design.md).
_provenance.typed_by_hand_from: games/sonic4/data/levels/ojz/act1/act_descriptor.emp, OJZ_ACT1_REGION_ROWS, RELEASE shape, at aeon 6a7e4464. The ten rows were transcribed from the .emp call sites and the constants they name (OJZ_NIGHT_X0 = 3400, OJZ_NIGHT_X1 = 4799, OJZ_SEC2_X1 = 6143 in release), NOT produced by the flattener they are used to test. The whole value of this file is that it is an INDEPENDENT statement of the same thing; generating it from tools/region_flatten.py would make every assertion against it circular.
_provenance.release_shape_only: The DEBUG shape carries an ELEVENTH row (OJZ_E2_SNAP_ROWS, a look fixture at x 5600..6143 y 0..2047 binding OJZ_Preset_NightSnap) and shortens row `sec2` to x1 = 5599 to make room. A regions document has no way to say `DEBUG` — the contract schema is closed and carries no shape key — so these ten rows are the release table and the DEBUG delta is an open item, booked in docs/DEFERRED_WORK.md under REGIONS-GOLDEN-GAP. Do not read a disagreement with a DEBUG ROM as a flattener defect.
_provenance.bindings_vocabulary: `preset`, `sceneRef` and `rasterRef` are the DOCUMENT's words, not .emp symbols, because both repos have to be able to check them. The .emp symbol a sceneRef lowers to (EditorSceneBinding_OJZ_Act1_SecN) is aeon's business and is derived at test time from the build's own listing, never typed here.
_provenance.night_is_the_point: Row 9 straddles the section line at x = 4096 and neither of its edges (3400, 4800) lands on a multiple of the 2048 section size. It is in this fixture because a document whose regions all sit on the section grid cannot tell a correct flattener from one that quietly snaps to sections, and cannot exercise the two rows (`sec1`, `sec2`) whose spans are the night region's complement rather than a section's width.
